g.text: P — Pain · I — Infection (UTI, chest, sepsis) · N — Nutrition (dehydrated? low Na/glucose?) ·
C — Constipation + Catheter (retention!) · H — Hydration + Hypoxia + Heart (MI/HF) ·
M — Meds (anticholinergics, sedatives, opioids, steroids — M04) · E — Environment (ward move,
sensory loss, sleep loss, restraints). CAM positive = acute onset + inattention + (disorganised
thinking OR altered consciousness). HYPOACTIVE (quiet, drowsy) kills most — missed, not mild.
DELIRIUM CARE: treat cause urgently + orient (clock, daylight, aids ON, family
photos, explain every touch) + hydrate/feed/mobilise + review meds (stop culprits) +
sleep (noise down, pain controlled, catheters OUT) + stay WITH (family sit-in, 1:1 if
unsafe) + antipsychotic ONLY if distressed/unsafe per doctor (low dose, short, review).
Restraints worsen delirium — last resort, prescribed, reviewed (PRO-I M6 Act 846 spirit).
DEMENTIA CARE: routine + familiar faces + one-step instructions + validate feelings
(\"you miss home — tell me about it\") not facts-argued; BPSD (agitation, wandering, sundown)
= unmet need first (pain? toilet? fear? boredom?) → redirect, music, walk-with, carer respite;
drugs last (antipsychotics raise stroke/death — specialist only). Safety: stove, meds, money,
roads, wandering plan (ID bracelet, neighbour alert, locked gates kindly explained).
DEPRESSION CARE: screen (GDS), suicide safety, grief support, activity + daylight + roles,
treat pain/insomnia/constipation (misery mimics), meds per doctor + adherence + review —
\"old + sad ≠ normal\" — treatable at every age. Overlap real: delirium ON dementia common —
